title: Supply of CCTV Surveillance System with Installation and Commissioning
matching_rationale: Product match is clear — CCTV surveillance system SITC. Indian Navy is a high-profile defence customer. However, this tender requires careful evaluation: (1) Defence procurement often has specific vendor empanelment requirements, (2) Commercial competitiveness and positioning against established defence vendors needs assessment, (3) Technical specifications may reference defence-grade standards not typically handled.
scope_summary: Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of a CCTV surveillance system for Indian Navy establishment in Kolkata. Includes IP cameras (4MP), NVRs, PoE switches, cabling, and monitoring station setup. 5-year CAMC required.
key_requirements: Central monitoring station with video wall

eligibility_assessment.turnover_requirement: ₹3 Cr average annual turnover in last 3 financial years
eligibility_assessment.experience_requirement: Minimum 3 similar completed works of ₹40 Lakh each in CCTV/surveillance
eligibility_assessment.oem_authorization: Required — MAF from camera and NVR manufacturer
other_conditions: Defence establishment — security clearance may be required
Site visit logistics may be restricted
